name: equity-multiplier
notes: DuPont equity multiplier: TA/BE (low = low financial leverage). Selects sector-lowest 20% by TA/BE = most equity-financed firms. Distinct from LeverageReduction (H223, change) and DebtCoverage (H237, OCF/LTD). Clipped [1.0, 20.0]. Sector-neutral bottom 20% by EM, monthly rebalance.
